raw_text: That viral Indian Navy sinking video is 100% fake. I work in VFX and the water simulation is clearly CGI composited onto stock ocean footage. The ship model has no wake pattern, the lighting direction changes between cuts, and the hull markings don't match any active Indian Navy frigate. This is the laziest military propaganda I've seen. Pakistani accounts are pushing it hard across platforms.
clean_text: Viral Indian Navy sinking video identified as fake by VFX professional. CGI water simulation on stock footage, no wake pattern, inconsistent lighting, hull markings match no active frigate.
